subject: Rhadoop to get the top 10 stocks of 2001

messages.author: 9257686b4b0b6014
messages.subject: Rhadoop to get the top 10 stocks of 2001
parts:
Hi
 
Since I am new to Rhadoop and R in general , I am facing some challenges. Below is the code that I wrote to retrieve the top 10 stocks. However, it is not working currently.  Could someone please assist me in understanding where I have gone wrong...Thanks..
 
Sys.setenv("HADOOP_CMD"="/opt/cloudera/parcels/CDH/bin/hadoop")
Sys.setenv("HADOOP_STREAMING"="/opt/cloudera/parcels/CDH-4.7.0-1.cdh4.7.0.p0.40/lib/hadoop-0.20-mapreduce/contrib/streaming/hadoop-streaming-2.0.0-mr1-cdh4.7.0.jar")
Sys.setenv("HADOOP_CONF"="/etc/hadoop/conf")
library("rhdfs")
library("rmr2")
stocks <- read.table("Stocks.txt")
hdfs.init()
stock_input <- to.dfs(stocks)
map <- function(k,v)
{
  fields <- unlist(strsplit(v,"," ))
 
  if(year(fields[3])==2001) keyval(fields[2],fields[8])  # fields[2] is stock name and fields[8] the volume
 
}
reduce <- function(k,v)
{
  topten <-sort(sapply(as.numeric(unlist(v)),1,sum),decreasing=TRUE)[1:10] 
 for(i in 1:len(topten))
{
  keyval(k,topten[i])
}
}
stlk<-mapreduce(input=stock_input,
               map=map,
               reduce=reduce,
               input.format = "text"
               # ,combine =T
               )
stock_output<-from.dfs(stlk)
